whatsNew: v1.0.43 updates the Android WebView to the normal mobile-responsive website layout at 85% scale.
Input fields no longer trigger automatic WebView zoom while typing or logging in.
The Android update screen has been redesigned as a full-screen update page with much larger text.
The update flow now uses the native Android installer instead of opening the APK in the browser.
Downloaded APKs are checked before installation to make sure the package is valid and is a newer signed build.
The app release footer now displays the current app version after the Contact section.
